name: 具有多个规格的传入物料的质量检验 (7GT)
name_en: Quality Inspection of Incoming Material with Multiple Specs (7GT)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item manages different quality inspection specification for an inspection characteristic. Different specifications may include customer requirements, requirements specified by pharmaceuticals or authorities, country-specific legal requirements, or internal company requirements.

At goods receipt, a good is posted to quality inspection stock and an inspection lot is created based on an inspection plan. The quality technician records the inspection results and data is transferred to the multiple specification automatically.

The quality engineer then makes a usage decision, for example, they accept or reject the material, or post the material to unrestricted stock or blocked stock. A batch can be valuated based on multiple specifications to determine the “suitability” of a material.

Key Process Flow

  • Create purchase order​
  • Post goods receipt and inspect lot creation
  • Record inspection results​ and data transfer to multiple specification automatically.
  • Make usage decision​
  • Display batch classification​

Business Benefits

  • Inspection plan with multiple specifications​
  • Automatic valuation of multiple specification​
  • Automatic transfer of results to batches​
  • Possible batch determination of allowed countries or customers
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目管理检验特征的不同质量检验规范。不同的规范可能包括客户要求、药品或当局指定的要求、国家/地区特定法律要求或公司内部要求。

收货时，将货物过账到质量检验库存，并根据检验计划创建检验批次。质量技术员记录检验结果，并自动将数据传输到多个规格。

然后，质量工程师制定使用决策，例如，他们接受或拒绝物料，或将物料过账到非限制库存或冻结库存。可以根据多重规范评估批次，以确定物料的“适合性”。

关键流程流

  • 创建采购订单​
  • 过账收货和检验批创建
  • 记录检验结果并自动将数据传输到多个规格。
  • 制定使用决策​
  • 显示批次分类​

业务优势

  • 含多重规范的检验计划​
  • 自动评估多个规格​
  • 将结果自动传输到批次​
  • 可能确定允许的国家/地区或客户的批次
